exclusion_proof: A nonzero local D-density has integrand dimension 2. Pure chiral or pure antichiral terms are Kähler-exact, so the only matter kinetic density contains one widetilde Phi and one Phi.
A local chiral Lorentz scalar obeys N_Phi + (3/2) N_W <= 3 and N_W is even. Therefore the only cases are N_W = 0 with N_Phi <= 3, or N_W = 2 with N_Phi = 0.
Any nonconstant Phi-dependence of f_AB requires a negative-mass-dimension interaction coefficient and is excluded.
Gauge invariance of a pure-mathcal V D-density leaves only the linear Abelian-quotient Fayet-Iliopoulos term.
A field-independent rigid F-density and a field-independent rigid D-density vanish under their ordered Berezin projectors.
